description: This Zenodo deposit republishes provincial population data and projections for Viet Nam from 1995 through 2050, citing the General Statistics Office and UNFPA 2016 publication. A public ZIP of about 21 KB is labelled CC BY 4.0. Provincial population is a useful demand driver for electricity, water, transport and public-service capacity simulations, particularly when comparing urban growth across regions. The record is a demographic input, not a prediction of infrastructure demand or proof that the projection has occurred. Its public page does not describe the age bands, scenario assumptions, table units or how the years after the source publication were generated. It also does not resolve whether the Zenodo copy and UNFPA source carry identical reuse terms. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this provincial release. The ZIP was not downloaded, so province codes, historical versus projected columns and file structure were not checked.
name: Provincial population data of Vietnam from 1995 to 2050
notes: G6 item G6-2278. Metadata-only draft. Simulation-use and type tags are reviewer classifications. File contents and software execution were not checked. Unknown maturity does not assert active maintenance.
